Unsupervised Learning of Microbial Community Structure by Body Site

Nkiruka Cynthia Efenji

# ==============================================================================
# SETUP 
# ==============================================================================

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)
# ==============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================

library(here)
## here() starts at /home/nkiruka/bioinformatics/hmpv13-microbiome-analysis
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(vegan)
## Loading required package: permute
library(reshape2)
library(cluster)
library(patchwork)

# Create directories (relative to project root)
dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Project root:", here(), "\n")
## Project root: /home/nkiruka/bioinformatics/hmpv13-microbiome-analysis
# Load dataset
load(here("data", "HMPv13.rda"))
ps <- HMPv13
ps
## phyloseq-class experiment-level object
## otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 5830 taxa and 3285 samples ]
## sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 3285 samples by 31 sample variables ]
## tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 5830 taxa by 7 taxonomic ranks ]
## phy_tree()    Phylogenetic Tree: [ 5830 tips and 5829 internal nodes ]
# ==============================================================================
# DATA EXPLORATION
# ==============================================================================

# Number of taxa (microbial features)
ntaxa(ps)
## [1] 5830
# Number of samples
nsamples(ps)
## [1] 3285
# Metadata variables
sample_variables(ps)
##  [1] "X.SampleID"                  "BarcodeSequence"            
##  [3] "LinkerPrimerSequence"        "run_prefix"                 
##  [5] "body_habitat"                "body_product"               
##  [7] "body_site"                   "bodysite"                   
##  [9] "dna_extracted"               "elevation"                  
## [11] "env"                         "env_biome"                  
## [13] "env_feature"                 "env_material"               
## [15] "env_package"                 "geo_loc_name"               
## [17] "host_common_name"            "host_scientific_name"       
## [19] "host_subject_id"             "host_taxid"                 
## [21] "latitude"                    "longitude"                  
## [23] "physical_specimen_location"  "physical_specimen_remaining"
## [25] "psn"                         "public"                     
## [27] "sample_type"                 "scientific_name"            
## [29] "sequencecenter"              "title"                      
## [31] "Description"
# Taxonomic levels
rank_names(ps)
## [1] "Kingdom" "Phylum"  "Class"   "Order"   "Family"  "Genus"   "Species"
# Identify body site variable
sample_variables(ps)
##  [1] "X.SampleID"                  "BarcodeSequence"            
##  [3] "LinkerPrimerSequence"        "run_prefix"                 
##  [5] "body_habitat"                "body_product"               
##  [7] "body_site"                   "bodysite"                   
##  [9] "dna_extracted"               "elevation"                  
## [11] "env"                         "env_biome"                  
## [13] "env_feature"                 "env_material"               
## [15] "env_package"                 "geo_loc_name"               
## [17] "host_common_name"            "host_scientific_name"       
## [19] "host_subject_id"             "host_taxid"                 
## [21] "latitude"                    "longitude"                  
## [23] "physical_specimen_location"  "physical_specimen_remaining"
## [25] "psn"                         "public"                     
## [27] "sample_type"                 "scientific_name"            
## [29] "sequencecenter"              "title"                      
## [31] "Description"
table(sample_data(ps)$body_site)
## 
##             UBERON:anterior nares              UBERON:buccal mucosa 
##                               187                               204 
##             UBERON:central vagina                      UBERON:feces 
##                                98                               210 
##                    UBERON:gingiva                UBERON:hard palate 
##                               204                               200 
##                      UBERON:mouth            UBERON:palatine tonsil 
##                               182                               203 
## UBERON:posterior fornix of vagina              UBERON:skin of elbow 
##                                98                               360 
##       UBERON:skin of external ear                     UBERON:throat 
##                               419                               195 
##                     UBERON:tongue                      UBERON:tooth 
##                               213                               417 
##          UBERON:vaginal introitus 
##                                95
# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT COMPONENTS
# ==============================================================================

# OTU table (taxa x samples)
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))

# Metadata
metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))

# Ensure orientation is correct (samples should be rows)
otu <- t(otu)
# ==============================================================================
# 4. CHECK DIMENSIONS
# ==============================================================================

cat("OTU table:", dim(otu), "\n")
## OTU table: 3285 5830
cat("Metadata:", dim(metadata), "\n")
## Metadata: 3285 31
# ==============================================================================
# MATCH SAMPLE IDs
# ==============================================================================

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu), rownames(metadata))

otu <- otu[common_samples, ]
metadata <- metadata[common_samples, ]

# ==============================================================================
# SELECT BODY SITE VARIABLE 
# ==============================================================================

metadata$Site <- metadata$body_site   # standardized variable

# ==============================================================================
# FILTER LOW-ABUNDANCE TAXA
# ==============================================================================

# Remove taxa with very low counts across all samples
otu_filtered <- otu[, colSums(otu) > 10]

# WHY:
# - Removes noise
# - Reduces dimensionality
# - Improves clustering stability

# ==============================================================================
# NORMALIZATION (RELATIVE ABUNDANCE)
# ==============================================================================

otu_rel <- sweep(otu_filtered, 1, rowSums(otu_filtered), FUN = "/")

# WHY:
# - Samples have different sequencing depth
# - We care about proportions, not raw counts

# ==============================================================================
# LOG TRANSFORMATION 
# ==============================================================================

otu_log <- log1p(otu_rel)

# WHY:
# - Microbiome data is highly skewed
# - Log stabilizes variance

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE OUTPUT
# ==============================================================================

saveRDS(otu_log, here("results", "otu_processed.rds"))
saveRDS(metadata, here("results", "metadata.rds"))
saveRDS(otu_filtered, here("results", "otu_filtered_raw.rds"))

cat("✓ Saved to results/\n")
## ✓ Saved to results/
cat("✓ Data preprocessing complete!\n")
## ✓ Data preprocessing complete!
cat("✓ Processed data saved to results/\n")
## ✓ Processed data saved to results/
# ==============================================================================
# PCoA ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

otu <- readRDS(here("results", "otu_processed.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(here("results", "metadata.rds"))

cat("Loaded OTU data:", dim(otu), "\n")
## Loaded OTU data: 3285 3130
# ==============================================================================
# DISTANCE MATRIX
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nComputing Bray-Curtis distance matrix...\n")
## 
## Computing Bray-Curtis distance matrix...
cat("(This may take 1-2 minutes for large datasets)\n")
## (This may take 1-2 minutes for large datasets)
bray_dist <- vegdist(otu, method = "bray")

cat("✓ Distance matrix computed!\n")
## ✓ Distance matrix computed!
saveRDS(bray_dist, here("results", "bray_curtis.rds"))

cat("✓ Saved to results/\n")
## ✓ Saved to results/
# ==============================================================================
# PCoA
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming PCoA...\n")
## 
## Performing PCoA...
pcoa <- cmdscale(bray_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)

# Save PCoA coordinates
write.csv(pcoa_df,
          here("results", "pcoa_coordinates.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

cat("✓ PCoA coordinates saved to results/pcoa_coordinates.csv\n")
## ✓ PCoA coordinates saved to results/pcoa_coordinates.csv
colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCo1", "PCo2")

# Attach body site by matching sample IDs (safe even if row order differs)
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)
pcoa_df$Site <- metadata$Site[match(rownames(pcoa_df), metadata$X.SampleID)]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(pcoa_df$Site)))

# Calculate variance explained
eigenvalues <- pcoa$eig
var_explained <- (eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)) * 100

cat("Variance explained:\n")
## Variance explained:
cat("  PCo1:", round(var_explained[1], 2), "%\n")
##   PCo1: 15.44 %
cat("  PCo2:", round(var_explained[2], 2), "%\n")
##   PCo2: 8.32 %
# ==============================================================================
# PLOT A: PCoA COLOURED BY BODY SITE
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCreating plot...\n")
## 
## Creating plot...
p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis Distance)",
    x = paste0("PCo1 (", round(var_explained[1], 2), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PCo2 (", round(var_explained[2], 2), "% variance)"),
    color = "Body Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p)

cat("✓ Plot created!\n")
## ✓ Plot created!
ggsave(here("figures", "pcoa_plot.png"), p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Plot saved to figures/pcoa_plot.png\n")
## ✓ Plot saved to figures/pcoa_plot.png
# ==============================================================================
# PLOT A (SUPPLEMENT): ONE PANEL PER BODY SITE
# Overplotting hides samples in the single panel above, so each body site is
# highlighted in its own panel with all other samples shown in grey.
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCreating per-site panels...\n")
## 
## Creating per-site panels...
p_facets <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2)) +
  geom_point(data = transform(pcoa_df, Site = NULL),
             colour = "grey85", size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Site), size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA by body site (Bray-Curtis)",
    x = paste0("PCo1 (", round(var_explained[1], 2), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PCo2 (", round(var_explained[2], 2), "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_facets)

ggsave(here("figures", "pcoa_by_site_facets.png"),
       p_facets, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Per-site panels saved to figures/pcoa_by_site_facets.png\n")
## ✓ Per-site panels saved to figures/pcoa_by_site_facets.png
# ==============================================================================
# CLUSTERING ANALYSIS (PAM / K-MEDOIDS on Bray-Curtis)
# PAM works directly on any dissimilarity matrix,
# so it is a suitable method for non-Euclidean ecological distances.
# ==============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(cluster)
library(patchwork)

cat("\n=== CLUSTERING ANALYSIS (PAM) ===\n")
## 
## === CLUSTERING ANALYSIS (PAM) ===
# Load data
metadata <- readRDS(here("results", "metadata.rds"))
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)

bray_dist <- readRDS(here("results", "bray_curtis.rds"))
pcoa_df <- read.csv(here("results", "pcoa_coordinates.csv"), row.names = 1)

colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCo1", "PCo2")

# Align metadata
metadata_sub <- metadata[match(rownames(pcoa_df), metadata$X.SampleID), ]
pcoa_df$body_site <- metadata_sub$body_site

if (any(is.na(pcoa_df$body_site))) {
  stop("❌ Metadata alignment failed!")
}

cat("✓ Data loaded and aligned\n")
## ✓ Data loaded and aligned
# ==============================================================================
# PAM (K-MEDOIDS) CLUSTERING
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n--- PAM Clustering ---\n")
## 
## --- PAM Clustering ---
# Make sure the distance matrix and the PCoA table are in the same sample order
stopifnot(identical(rownames(pcoa_df), attr(bray_dist, "Labels")))

k <- length(unique(pcoa_df$body_site))
pam_result <- pam(bray_dist, k = k, diss = TRUE)

pcoa_df$cluster <- as.factor(pam_result$clustering)

cat("✓ Clustering complete\n")
## ✓ Clustering complete
cat("\n--- PAM cluster sizes ---\n")
## 
## --- PAM cluster sizes ---
print(table(pcoa_df$cluster))

# VISUALIZATION 4: CLUSTERING QUALITY METRIC
clustering_quality <- data.frame()

for (site in unique(pcoa_df$body_site)) {
  site_samples <- pcoa_df[pcoa_df$body_site == site, ]
  best_cluster <- names(sort(table(site_samples$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  purity <- sum(site_samples$cluster == best_cluster) / nrow(site_samples)
  
  clustering_quality <- rbind(clustering_quality, 
                              data.frame(BodySite = site, 
                                       Purity = purity * 100,
                                       BestCluster = best_cluster))
}

p_quality <- ggplot(clustering_quality, 
                    aes(x = reorder(BodySite, Purity), y = Purity, fill = Purity)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Purity, 1), "%")), 
            vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FF6B6B", high = "#4ECDC4") +
  labs(
    title = "Clustering Purity by Body Site",
    subtitle = "Percentage of each body site that clusters together",
    x = "Body Site",
    y = "Purity (%)",
    fill = "Purity"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 105) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
## Warning in geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.5): Ignoring unknown parameters:
## `size`
print(p_quality)

ggsave(here("figures", "clustering_purity.png"),
       p_quality, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ==============================================================================
# COMBINED FIGURE PANEL
# A: PCoA by body site | B: cluster sizes
# C: body site composition by cluster | D: purity by body site
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n--- Building combined 4-panel figure ---\n")
## 
## --- Building combined 4-panel figure ---
library(patchwork)

# Strip the "UBERON:" prefix so labels fit in the smaller panels
strip_uberon <- function(x) sub("UBERON:", "", x)

# PCoA plot from the PCoA chunk (still in memory as `p`)
p_pcoa <- p

pA <- p_pcoa +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = strip_uberon) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis)", color = "Body site") +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

pB <- p_cluster_size +
  labs(title = "Cluster size")

# Legend dropped here: panel A's legend covers it, and both use the same 15
# body sites in the same order, so the colours match
pC <- p_composition +
  labs(title = "Body site composition by cluster", subtitle = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

pD <- p_quality +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = strip_uberon) +
  labs(title = "Purity by body site", subtitle = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1))

figure_panel <- (pA + pB) / (pC + pD) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "HMPv13: body-site structure of the human microbiome (Bray-Curtis; PAM clustering, k = 15)",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
  ) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(here("figures", "figure_panel.png"),
       figure_panel, width = 16, height = 11, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Combined figure panel saved to figures/figure_panel.png\n")
## ✓ Combined figure panel saved to figures/figure_panel.png

clustering_summary <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(pcoa_df),
  body_site = pcoa_df$body_site,
  cluster = pcoa_df$cluster
)

write.csv(clustering_summary,
          here("results", "clustering_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Confusion matrix in long format with readable column names
confusion_out <- as.data.frame(confusion_matrix)
colnames(confusion_out) <- c("Cluster", "BodySite", "Count")

write.csv(confusion_out,
          here("results", "confusion_matrix.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(clustering_quality,
          here("results", "clustering_quality_metrics.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
